name: crm-lookup-select
description: CRM-backed lookup field (hs-uix CrmLookupSelect from common-components) — a Select that searches live CRM records as the user types (debounced, paginated). Point it at an `objectType` + `properties`; map the option shape with `labelProperty` / `valueProperty` / `descriptionProperty` (string property names). Bind the picked value with the `$bindState` sibling key — do NOT hand-wire value + onChange. Add `multiple: true` for a MultiSelect. Use this instead of a static Select whenever the choices ARE CRM records (pick a company, contact, deal). For a fixed option list, use a plain Select.
